r.경제 체제: Nordic welfare-state market economy · telecom equipment, trucks, machinery
r.주식시장 시가총액: $289.9 billion, 87% of GDP (2003, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.16 for a Big Mac, $0.94 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)

t.why: It ended more than 200 years of non-alignment and joined NATO in 2024. It awards the Nobel Prizes.
t.rel: It has a long history of cooperation with Norway, Denmark, Finland and Iceland through the Nordic Council, with passport-free travel. It pursued NATO membership together with Finland, and the Oresund Bridge links it with Denmark into a single commuting area. It monitors the Baltic jointly with its neighbors over suspected Russian damage to undersea cables.
t.korea: It sent a medical unit during the Korean War and, since the armistice, has kept a Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission delegation at Panmunjom.
t.know: In Jukkasjarvi in the north, a hotel is rebuilt out of ice every winter.
t.etext: It has built world-class companies in telecom equipment, trucks, machinery, pharmaceuticals, furniture and music streaming. It is also rich in iron ore and timber.
